codeReview.summary: The implementation is small, focused, and mostly aligned with the feature intent: mobile-first `sm:` responsive compaction was applied to header spacing and typography while preserving 44px touch targets. I found one non-blocking desktop behavior regression risk.

issues.description: Desktop behavior is no longer strictly unchanged because `truncate` is applied unconditionally to both title and date text (`h1` at line 562 and date span at line 567). Before this commit, these fields could wrap; now they are forced to single-line ellipsis at all breakpoints. Consider making truncation mobile-only (e.g., restore non-truncated behavior at `sm:` and above).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `frontend-worker` skill procedure is overly map3d-specific for non-map3d features: it mandates reading `.factory/plans/3d-terrain-map3d-refactor.md` as step 1 even when the feature is a simple mobile-header Tailwind change. The reviewed worker did not read that file but still delivered correctly.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/frontend-worker/SKILL.md:20 requires reading the map3d refactor plan; worker-transcripts.jsonl entry for session 95bee174-45c9-4d92-8122-111c43231b3f shows reads of mission/validation/README/services/architecture/TripDetail but no read of .factory/plans/3d-terrain-map3d-refactor.md.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Chrome DevTools viewport behavior for mobile validation (requested 390x844 but reported CSS width 500 due DPR/window constraints) is not captured in shared testing guidance, which can cause confusion when asserting pixel-perfect mobile widths.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff file for this feature notes the mismatch and recommendation: handoffs/2026-04-06T08-20-33-485Z__mobile-header-compact__95bee174-45c9-4d92-8122-111c43231b3f.json:60. Existing guidance still states fixed 390x844 without caveat: .factory/library/user-testing.md:8,22 and .factory/skills/frontend-worker/SKILL.md:47.
